action_types.ANSWER_QUESTION: Atomically store one canonical domain answer and ANSWERED lifecycle.
action_types.CLEAR_ANSWER: Remove one answer and reactivate its exact question.
action_types.SET_SUBJECT_LOCATION: Persist an anchor or frame-local source-coordinate subject location.
action_types.CLEAR_SUBJECT_LOCATION: Remove one source-coordinate subject location without changing unrelated truth.
action_types.SELECT_CANDIDATE: Select one exact frame-local frozen candidate.
action_types.DESELECT_CANDIDATE: Deselect one exact frame-local frozen candidate.
action_types.ADD_MISSED_PERSON_MARK: Add one exact frame-local source-coordinate missed-person mark.
action_types.REMOVE_MISSED_PERSON_MARK: Remove one missed-person mark by immutable mark ID.
action_types.COMPLETE_MISSED_PERSON_MARKING: Confirm that the current missed-person mark set is complete.
action_types.CONFIRM_SUBJECT_CONTINUITY: Persist marker, occlusion, or burst-local continuity confirmation.
action_types.NAVIGATE_BACK: Move to the prior server-authorized question.
action_types.NAVIGATE_FORWARD: Move to the next server-authorized question.
